smart_box.name: SBBox-Navigation
smart_box.description: Smart Box responsible for controlling logical movement through the ordered pages of the educational book.

page_id.description: Stable identifier of a page used when directly navigating to a page.

can_go_next.description: Whether navigation can move to the next page.

can_go_previous.description: Whether navigation can move to the previous page.

rules: Navigation operates on the logical page order provided by BookCatalog.
The current page is identified by a stable page identifier.
Navigation must respect the first-page and last-page boundaries.
Navigation does not modify the logical structure of the book.
Navigation does not render or load page images.
Navigation does not control narration playback.
Navigation does not depend on a specific technology or provider.
Navigation exposes WHAT movement is requested, not HOW movement is implemented.
